units.source_text: 这个流沙的印象，给了他一种说不出来的冲击和兴奋。

en.t: This impression of shifting sand gave him an indescribable shock and excitement.

units.source_text: 沙地上寸草不生，但并非人们所想象的，单纯由干旱造成。

en.t: Not a blade of grass grew on the sandy ground, but this was not simply caused by drought, as people imagined.

units.source_text: 其实，不停的流动，正是沙子拒绝接受所有生物的理由。

en.t: In fact, its ceaseless movement was precisely the reason sand refused to accept any living thing.

units.source_text: 一年中必须不停顿地强逼着紧紧抓住，与这个现实的郁闷相比起来，是怎样一种错误呐。

en.t: What a mistake it was, compared with the gloom of this reality, to be forced all year long to cling tightly without pause.
